segments.text:
Your betters have waited long upon God for
mercy, and why should not you? David waited
till his eyes failed, Psal. 69. 3 The Church waited
for him in the way of his judgements, Isa. 26. 8.
Are you better than all the Saints that are gone
before you? Is God more obliged to you than
to all his people? They have quietly waited, and
why should not you?
